This description is partly mechanistic and partly phenomenological. The estimation of the parameters is based on statistical methodology. The model predicts that relatively short antibiotic-free time periods are sufficient to re-obtain low MIC-values. For tetracyclin, the method works fine. For amoxicillin, we observed one experiment with inherited resistance, which we could not incorporate in our statistical analysis. As a result, there are too few experiments 1 Springer
